content:
leah: quick sync: need to finalize "in-place preserve" upgrade lane for private deploys. Goal: zero IP churn, operator-first UX.

omar: +1. Two blockers: (1) ACL diffs applied atomically, (2) DNS/ARP sticky timing.

sid: For ACL diffs I'm prototyping acl-apply --atomic --dry-run. Example: ```acl-apply --from=rev5 --to=rev6 --tenant t-42 --dry-run``` -> prints commit plan + rollback commands.

leah: good. launch checklist draft: offline installer, dry-run + simulation harness, handshake API for netops, KMS key access verified, pilot with 4 tenants.

omar: Add migration-risk field to releases. If risk >= 7 require exec signoff & legal for HSM.

sid: telemetry: tag events with lane=inplace-preserve, release, tenant-topology. Need to export to observability for 1h after cutover.

ops-bot: [alert] pilot rollout scheduled: PRD-PLAT-657 -> canary tenants: 4. Logs: https://deploy/redwood/657

leah: owners: leah (PM), sid (tools), omar (ops). I'll circulate final checklist and schedule the pilot maintenance windows. Meeting 10:30 tomorrow to lock bundling (thin-agent vs monolith).

omar: noted. short follow-up: include explicit rollback runbook in docs with commands and expected timings.

leah: will add. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
